reports.text: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/204014/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-hpe-juniper-session-smart-conductor-and-session-smart-router-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html), [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-10-vulnerabilities.html) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added vulnerabilities affecting HPE, Danfoss, Mitel MiCollab, Vates Xen Orchestra, and Juniper to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/drupal-idunno-anticsrf-optimizely-flaws-exploited/) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added three flaws affecting Drupal Core, Idunno AntiCsrf, and Optimizely Web Experimentation to its catalog.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/hackers-exploit-n-able-mailassure-flaw.html), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203882/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-n-able-mailassure-and-project-monai-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added flaws impacting N-able MailAssure and Project MONAI to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/cisa-warns-vmware-sap-cisco-apache-roller-flaws-exploited/) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added four vulnerabilities affecting VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, and Apache Roller to its catalog.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/sap-netweaver-cisco-expressway-flaws-exploited-in-attacks/) reported that SAP NetWeaver and Cisco Expressway flaws could be exploited by threat actors to leak or modify server information and to execute commands as root.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/flaws-in-synology-litellm-apache-axis-and-redcap/), [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203504/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-apache-axis-vanderbilt-redcapberriai-litellm-and-synology-dsm-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added four flaws in Synology, LiteLLM, Apache Axis, and REDCap to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
[Check Point Research](https://research.checkpoint.com/2026/the-state-of-ransomware-q3-2026/) reported that ransomware reached record levels in Q3 2026.

[Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203377/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-perforce-puppet-enterprise-flaw-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) reported that U.S. CISA added the Perforce Puppet Enterprise vulnerability CVE-2026-115731 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

[Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203040/hacking/u-s-cisa-adds-check-point-and-unrealircd-flaws-to-its-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog.html) reported that the U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency added Check Point and UnrealIRCd flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

[CISA](https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2026/11/13/cisa-adds-two-known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog) reported that CISA added two new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog based on evidence of active exploitation, including CVE-2026-114713.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/cisa-flags-sonicwall-sonicos-mfa-bypass.html) reported that CISA added a high-severity vulnerability impacting SonicWall SonicOS to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog amid reports of possible exploitation.

narratives.title: U.S. CISA adds Drupal Core, Idunno AntiCsrf, and Optimizely Web Experimentation flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog

reports.text: [Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203931/security/vmware-patches-critical-vcenter-authentication-bypass-and-esx-flaws.html) reported that Broadcom patched 23 VMware flaws, covering a critical vCenter authentication bypass and three flaws allowing code execution on ESX hosts.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/vmware-vcenter-hit-by-another-critical.html) reported that Broadcom shipped patches to address vulnerabilities impacting VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, Fusion, and Avi Load Balancer.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/microsoft-entra-connect-health-flaw-exploited-to-steal-tenant-data/) reported that Microsoft warned organizations of a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to gain unauthorized access.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/microsoft-entra-connect-health-flaw/) reported that attackers exploited a flaw in Microsoft Entra Connect Health to read administrator and technical contact email addresses, alongside organization configuration data.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/critical-apache-tomcat-flaw/) reported that the Apache Software Foundation disclosed a critical flaw in Apache Tomcat allowing remote attackers to join a trusted server cluster without authentication.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/china-linked-hackers-exploit-critical.html) reported that a China-nexus cyber espionage group known as Armory Castle has been attributed to the zero-day exploitation of a critical VMware vCenter security flaw.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/newly-patched-vmware-vcenter-flaw-exploited-as-zero-day-by-chinese-apt/) reported that Google stated a China-linked espionage group exploited a critical VMware vCenter authentication bypass before Broadcom released a patch.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/vmware-patches-vcenter-zero-day-exploited-in-attacks-since-september/) reported that Broadcom released security updates to fix a critical VMware vCenter Server authentication bypass vulnerability exploited by Chinese-linked hackers since September.

[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-vmware-vcenter-flaw-cvss-98.html) reported that a critical flaw in VMware vCenter lets an attacker with network access bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/vmware-vcenter-authentication-bypass/) reported that Broadcom released fixes for five VMware flaws, including one that lets anyone with network access skip login.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/apache-warns-of-roller-rce-vulnerability-exploited-in-attacks/) reported that Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers.
[The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/critical-apache-roller-rce-flaw-under.html) reported that a critical security flaw in Apache Roller is under active exploitation in the wild.

[Security Affairs](https://securityaffairs.com/203419/security/apache-roller-rce-flaw-cve-2026-129448-under-active-attack.html) reported that attackers are exploiting an Apache Roller flaw that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
[Sophos X-Ops](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/blog/patches-released-for-critical-nginx2root-vulnerabilities) reported that patches have been released for critical NGINX2Root vulnerabilities.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-http-server-rce-exploitation/) reported that Apache’s HTTP/2 module has a critical flaw tracked as CVE-2026-119618 that allows unauthenticated remote code execution.

[SecurityWeek](https://www.securityweek.com/apache-patches-critical-http-server-rce-found-by-anthropic-google/) reported that the mod_http2 race condition, CVE-2026-119618, was found by Anthropic and Google.

[BleepingComputer](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/apache-http-server-patches-critical-http-2-remote-code-execution-flaw/) reported that a critical vulnerability in the HTTP/2 module of Apache HTTP Server could be exploited by an unauthenticated attacker to obtain remote code execution.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/palo-alto-networks-pan-os-rce-vulnerability/) reported that Palo Alto Networks disclosed a remote code execution vulnerability in PAN-OS software running on Panorama, tracked as CVE-2026-0330.

[Cybersecurity News](https://cybersecuritynews.com/apache-patches-critical-http-2-flaw/) reported that Apache fixed a critical bug in its HTTP/2 module, tracked as CVE-2026-119618, that could let a remote attacker run code on a web server.
